title: Keep before-and-after photos on a client

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Keep before and after photos with the client they belong to. Start by opening the client.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: We'll use Rosa and Stefan Ferrante.

steps.caption: Project Photos
steps.narration: Scroll down to Project Photos. There is nothing here for this client yet.

steps.caption: The stage
steps.narration: Photos are filed as In progress or Finished. The list starts on In progress.

steps.caption: Add photos
steps.narration: Choose Add photos, and pick them from your computer or your phone.

steps.caption: Uploading
steps.narration: They upload one after the other.

steps.caption: Tagged In progress
steps.narration: Here they are. Each one is tagged In progress.

steps.caption: Switch to Finished
steps.narration: When the job is done, switch the list to Finished.

steps.caption: Add the after shot
steps.narration: Then add the after shot the same way.

steps.caption: Before and after
steps.narration: Now the before and the after sit side by side, each with its tag.

steps.caption: Delete
steps.narration: Point at a photo and a small bin appears, to delete it.

steps.caption: The client's portal
steps.narration: Now your client, signed in to their portal.

steps.caption: The same photos
steps.narration: The same three photos are there. They can add their own with Add a photo.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Project Photos is on every client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: How to keep before-and-after photos on a client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Add in-progress and finished photos to a client's page in ConstructHUB CRM, see each one tagged with its stage, and check how the client sees them in their portal. The walkthrough uses a demo company, a demo client and drawn sample photos.
